# PRSPARES — Wholesale Mobile Phone Repair Parts (Factory-Direct, Shenzhen)

> PRSPARES (phonerepairspares.com) is a Shenzhen/Huaqiangbei factory-direct **B2B wholesale** supplier of mobile phone repair parts for independent repair shops, parts distributors, refurbishers, and online resellers worldwide. Core products: LCD/OLED screen assemblies (Original / Soft OLED / Hard OLED / Incell grades), replacement batteries, cameras, charging ports, flex cables, IC chips, and repair tools — covering iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Huawei, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and Google Pixel. Differentiators: factory-direct pricing (no middleman), 10+ years in repair parts, strict incoming-material QC, 12-month warranty, published tiered pricing (10+ / 50+ / 200+ units), and detailed English repair-cost and sourcing guides. Primary markets: USA, UK, Europe (expanding Canada, Australia, Mexico). Retail/single-unit sales are not offered — buyers submit a wholesale inquiry (RFQ).

## Key Pages
- [Wholesale Inquiry / RFQ](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/wholesale-inquiry): Request factory-direct wholesale pricing — the primary way B2B buyers engage PRSPARES.
- [iPhone Screen Grades Explained — Original vs Soft OLED vs Hard OLED vs Incell](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/products/screens-grade-guide): The four-grade standard used across the catalog, with live wholesale price ranges and True Tone notes.
- [About PRSPARES](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/about): Shenzhen factory-direct supplier, 10+ years in mobile phone repair parts, QC and 12-month warranty.
- [Contact](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/contact): Reach the wholesale team for sourcing and bulk orders.

## Wholesale Terms (facts buyers ask about most)
- **Minimum order:** There is no single-model MOQ. Mix any models, grades and product categories; the published 10+ tier price applies to every line once the order totals 10 pcs. Trial orders start at 5 pcs at the same 10+ unit price, with freight billed separately.
- **Pricing tiers:** Published per-SKU pricing at 10+ / 50+ / 200+ units. Wholesale rates move frequently — confirm a live quote before ordering.
- **Screen grades and July 2026 price ranges** (per unit, 10+ tier, 188 iPhone screen SKUs across 27 models):
  - *Original* — refurbished original panel (factory OLED cell refitted with new glass; not a sealed Apple Service Pack, stated openly). $18.81–$304.37
  - *Soft OLED* — flexible OLED, closest aftermarket match to stock display. $13.65–$120.17
  - *Hard OLED* — rigid OLED, mid-tier. $34.22–$74.96
  - *Incell* — LCD-based budget tier. $8.23–$45.13
- **True Tone:** True Tone data lives on the original screen's IC. Original, Soft OLED and Hard OLED assemblies accept a True Tone transfer with a programmer (JC V1SE, i2C, JCID). On Incell SKUs support varies by batch — confirm before ordering.
- **Panel brands stocked:** JK (40 SKUs / 23 models, $12.90–$120.17), GX (23 SKUs / 18 models, $9.21–$64.12), DD (20 SKUs, hard OLED), RJ (7 SKUs). PRSPARES is an independent wholesaler, not affiliated with these panel factories; brand names identify compatibility only.
- **Warranty:** 12-month warranty and RMA support on all grades; every batch passes incoming and outgoing QC (touch, brightness, True Tone where applicable).

States openly that on July 2026 like-for-like price checks a US shop's realistic saving is roughly 0–15% on small orders once freight, duty and payment fees are counted; the widely quoted 30–40% applies where the local distributor tier is thinner or adds two markups instead of one.
